tasks.label: Windows: Build (Debug)
args: $vswhere='C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; $msbuild=(& $vswhere -latest -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1); if(-not $msbuild){ throw 'MSBuild not found (install Visual Studio with the C++ workload)' }; & $msbuild 'build\re3.sln' -t:re3 -p:Configuration=Debug -p:Platform=win-amd64-librw_gl3_glfw-oal -m -nologo

tasks.label: Windows: Build & Deploy (Debug)
args: $gta='C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Grand Theft Auto 3'; Copy-Item -Force 'bin\win-amd64-librw_gl3_glfw-oal\Debug\re3.exe' (Join-Path $gta 're3.exe'); Copy-Item -Force 'bin\win-amd64-librw_gl3_glfw-oal\Debug\re3.pdb' (Join-Path $gta 're3.pdb'); Write-Host ('Deployed Debug build to ' + $gta)
